mapper.select: SELECT VAL.ISSUE_PARTY_ID as issuePartyId, VAL.ASSET_CODE as assetCode, VAL.VAL_DATE as valDate, VAL.UNIT_VAL_NET as unitValNet, VAL.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL as unitValTotal, VAL.REMARK as remark, '01' status/*新建状态*/ FROM CHB_AST_VAL VAL WHERE to_char(VAL.VAL_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and not exists (select 1 from CHB_AST_VAL_SUB SUB where SUB.VAL_DATE = VAL.VAL_DATE and SUB.ASSET_CODE = VAL.ASSET_CODE and SUB.SEND_STATUS in ('02','03') ) and not exists (select 1 from CHB_AST_VAL VAL2 where VAL2.VAL_DATE = VAL.VAL_DATE-1 and VAL2.ASSET_CODE = VAL.ASSET_CODE and VAL2.UNIT_VAL_NET = VAL.UNIT_VAL_NET and VAL2.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL = VAL.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL )

SELECT f_guid() REGIST_SEQNO, VAL.ISSUE_PARTY_ID as ISSUE_PARTY_ID, NVL(ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE_OLD,ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE) as ASSET_CODE, VAL.VAL_DATE as VAL_DATE, VAL.UNIT_VAL_NET as UNIT_VAL_NET, VAL.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL as UNIT_VAL_TOTAL, VAL.REMARK as REMARK, '01' STATUS, '01' SEND_STATUS, #{chbSubmitDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CHB_SUBMIT_DEADLINE, #{submitDeadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} SUBMIT_DEADLINE, VAL.ORG_CODE ORG_CODE, VAL.DEPT_CODE DEPT_CODE, 'system' CREATE_USER, sysdate CREATE_TIME, 'system' UPDATE_USER, sysdate UPDATE_TIME, #{statusDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} STATUS_DATE FROM CHB_AST_VAL VAL LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_INFO ASSETINFO ON ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE = VAL.ASSET_CODE
left join chb_asset_info_sub csb on csb.ASSET_CODE=VAL.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F ON csb.ASSET_CODE=F.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD PDD ON csb.ASSET_CODE = PDD.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID) DEAL ON DEAL.FINPROD_ID = csb.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT D.BUSINESS_ID,D.BELONG_INSTITUTION_CODE,D.DATA_TYPE FROM DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST D WHERE D.MODEL_TYPE = '02' GROUP BY D.BUSINESS_ID,D.BELONG_INSTITUTION_CODE,D.DATA_TYPE ) DA ON ((DA.BUSINESS_ID = F.FINPROD_ID OR DA.BUSINESS_ID=DEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID) and DATA_TYPE != 'PTL01') or (DA.BUSINESS_ID = PDD.PORTFOLIO_ID and DATA_TYPE = 'PTL01') LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_SUB_STATUS CS ON csb.REGIST_SEQNO=CS.REGIST_SEQNO AND CS.ASSET_TYPE='01'
WHERE to_char(VAL.VAL_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and not exists (select 1 from CHB_AST_VAL_SUB SUB where SUB.VAL_DATE = VAL.VAL_DATE and SUB.ASSET_CODE = NVL(ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE_OLD,ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE) and SUB.SEND_STATUS in ('02','03') )
AND( (CS.INSTITUTION_CODE =#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and F.TRADE_MARKET IS NOT NULL) or (F.TRADE_MARKET IS NULL and DA.BELONG_INSTITUTION_CODE=#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and CS.INSTITUTION_CODE=#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ))

SELECT sub.REGIST_SEQNO as registSeqno, VAL.ISSUE_PARTY_ID as issuePartyId, SUB.ASSET_CODE as assetCode, VAL.VAL_DATE as valDate, VAL.UNIT_VAL_NET as unitValNet, VAL.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL as unitValTotal, VAL.REMARK as remark, '02' status/*修改状态*/ FROM CHB_AST_VAL_SUB sub left join CHB_ASSET_INFO ASSETINFO ON NVL(ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE_OLD,ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE) = SUB.ASSET_CODE left join CHB_AST_VAL val on val.VAL_DATE = sub.VAL_DATE and val.ASSET_CODE = ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE and val.status in ('M','E')
left join chb_asset_info_sub csb on csb.ASSET_CODE=sub.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F ON csb.ASSET_CODE=F.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD PDD ON csb.ASSET_CODE = PDD.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID) DEAL ON DEAL.FINPROD_ID = csb.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT D.BUSINESS_ID,D.BELONG_INSTITUTION_CODE,D.DATA_TYPE FROM DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST D WHERE D.MODEL_TYPE = '02' GROUP BY D.BUSINESS_ID,D.BELONG_INSTITUTION_CODE,D.DATA_TYPE ) DA ON ((DA.BUSINESS_ID = F.FINPROD_ID OR DA.BUSINESS_ID=DEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID) and DATA_TYPE != 'PTL01') or (DA.BUSINESS_ID = PDD.PORTFOLIO_ID and DATA_TYPE = 'PTL01') LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_SUB_STATUS CS ON csb.REGIST_SEQNO=CS.REGIST_SEQNO AND CS.ASSET_TYPE='01'
WHERE to_char(sub.VAL_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and SUB.SEND_STATUS in ('02','03')
AND( (CS.INSTITUTION_CODE =#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and F.TRADE_MARKET IS NOT NULL) or (F.TRADE_MARKET IS NULL and DA.BELONG_INSTITUTION_CODE=#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and CS.INSTITUTION_CODE=#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ))
and SUB.STATUS in ('01','02') and (val.UNIT_VAL_NET <> SUB.UNIT_VAL_NET or val.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL <> SUB.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL) UNION ALL SELECT sub.REGIST_SEQNO as registSeqno, VAL.ISSUE_PARTY_ID as issuePartyId, SUB.ASSET_CODE as assetCode, VAL.VAL_DATE as valDate, VAL.UNIT_VAL_NET as unitValNet, VAL.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL as unitValTotal, VAL.REMARK as remark, '01' status/*新建状态*/ FROM CHB_AST_VAL_SUB sub left join CHB_ASSET_INFO ASSETINFO ON NVL(ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE_OLD,ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE) = SUB.ASSET_CODE left join CHB_AST_VAL val on val.VAL_DATE = sub.VAL_DATE and val.ASSET_CODE = ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE and val.status in ('M','E')
left join chb_asset_info_sub csb on csb.ASSET_CODE=sub.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F ON csb.ASSET_CODE=F.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD PDD ON csb.ASSET_CODE = PDD.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID) DEAL ON DEAL.FINPROD_ID = csb.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT D.BUSINESS_ID,D.BELONG_INSTITUTION_CODE,D.DATA_TYPE FROM DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST D WHERE D.MODEL_TYPE = '02' GROUP BY D.BUSINESS_ID,D.BELONG_INSTITUTION_CODE,D.DATA_TYPE ) DA ON ((DA.BUSINESS_ID = F.FINPROD_ID OR DA.BUSINESS_ID=DEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID) and DATA_TYPE != 'PTL01') or (DA.BUSINESS_ID = PDD.PORTFOLIO_ID and DATA_TYPE = 'PTL01') LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_SUB_STATUS CS ON csb.REGIST_SEQNO=CS.REGIST_SEQNO AND CS.ASSET_TYPE='01'
WHERE to_char(sub.VAL_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and SUB.SEND_STATUS in ('02','03') and SUB.STATUS ='03'
AND( (CS.INSTITUTION_CODE =#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and F.TRADE_MARKET IS NOT NULL) or (F.TRADE_MARKET IS NULL and DA.BELONG_INSTITUTION_CODE=#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and CS.INSTITUTION_CODE=#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ))
and( SUB.STATUS ='03' or (val.UNIT_VAL_NET <> SUB.UNIT_VAL_NET or val.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL <> SUB.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL)) union all SELECT sub.REGIST_SEQNO as registSeqno, sub.ISSUE_PARTY_ID as issuePartyId, SUB.ASSET_CODE as assetCode, sub.VAL_DATE as valDate, sub.UNIT_VAL_NET as unitValNet, sub.UNIT_VAL_TOTAL as unitValTotal, sub.REMARK as remark, '03' status/*删除状态*/ FROM CHB_AST_VAL_SUB sub left join CHB_ASSET_INFO ASSETINFO ON NVL(ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE_OLD,ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE) = SUB.ASSET_CODE
left join chb_asset_info_sub csb on csb.ASSET_CODE=sub.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT F ON csb.ASSET_CODE=F.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD PDD ON csb.ASSET_CODE = PDD.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID) DEAL ON DEAL.FINPROD_ID = csb.ASSET_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT D.BUSINESS_ID,D.BELONG_INSTITUTION_CODE,D.DATA_TYPE FROM DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST D WHERE D.MODEL_TYPE = '02' GROUP BY D.BUSINESS_ID,D.BELONG_INSTITUTION_CODE,D.DATA_TYPE ) DA ON ((DA.BUSINESS_ID = F.FINPROD_ID OR DA.BUSINESS_ID=DEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID) and DATA_TYPE != 'PTL01') or (DA.BUSINESS_ID = PDD.PORTFOLIO_ID and DATA_TYPE = 'PTL01') LEFT JOIN CHB_ASSET_SUB_STATUS CS ON csb.REGIST_SEQNO=CS.REGIST_SEQNO AND CS.ASSET_TYPE='01'
WHERE to_char(sub.VAL_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{generateDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and SUB.SEND_STATUS in ('02','03') and SUB.STATUS <>'03'
AND( (CS.INSTITUTION_CODE =#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and F.TRADE_MARKET IS NOT NULL) or (F.TRADE_MARKET IS NULL and DA.BELONG_INSTITUTION_CODE=#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and CS.INSTITUTION_CODE=#{InstitutionCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ))
and not exists( select 1 from CHB_AST_VAL val where to_char(val.VAL_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') = to_char(sub.VAL_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') and val.ASSET_CODE = ASSETINFO.ASSET_CODE and val.STATUS != 'D' )
